paras: Hemidactylus foudaii, also known commonly as the Elba gecko, is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is native to North Africa.
The specific name, foudaii, is in honor of Egyptian conservationist Moustafa Mokhtar Fouda.
H. foudaii is found in Egypt and possibly Sudan.
The natural habitats of H. foudaii are dry savanna, subtropical or tropical dry shrubland, and rocky areas, at altitudes up to 450 m (1,480 ft).
H. foudaii is threatened by habitat loss.
